comment: Never-worse ratchet: the gate fails when the problem count is HIGHER than this, and never on errors alone. Lower it whenever you fix something; nothing forces it down. Re-measure with `node scripts/release-checks.mjs lint --write` in a clean git worktree, so gitignored sibling checkouts on disk are not counted. It fell from 41 to 15 on 2026-10-24 with the store-scorecard-caution work, and since then `eslint .` reads exactly the files the store scanner reads: eslint.config.mjs uses the scanner's own hardcoded ignore list (obsidianmd/eslint-plugin PR #158), so this number and the scorecard count the same source. The drop did not come from the ignore list, which lints the same 127 files as the old one: the settings tab redraws through one helper instead of the deprecated `display()`, removing every `no-deprecated`, and the eight `fetch` defaults import `obsidianFetch` explicitly, removing every `no-restricted-globals` (the rest is earlier fixes this number was never lowered for). Nothing is silenced: no eslint-disable exists for obsidianmd/*, no-deprecated or no-restricted-globals. The composition today, all warnings, 0 errors. Scorecard-relevant, 4: 1 `settings-tab/prefer-setting-definitions` on `TaggedSyncSettingTab` (src/settings-tab.ts) -- DELIBERATE: `getSettingDefinitions()` needs Obsidian 1.13.0, far above minAppVersion; it lifts when the floor moves. 3 `prefer-window-timers` in src/llm-transcript.ts (`withTimeout` and `realSleep`): this file runs on Node in every test suite and the nightly as well as in Obsidian, `window` does not exist on Node, and `window.setTimeout` there once lost every rate-limited page in the nightly (see the comments at those lines). Not on the scorecard, 11 `ui/sentence-case` false positives on proper nouns and examples the rule cannot know: the product names `Tagged Sync Pro` and `Zotero` (src/settings-tab.ts x2, src/zotero-plugin.ts, src/zotero-send-dialog.ts x2, src/zotero-link-dialog.ts), the example search `Smith Prompting` (an author's name, in both Zotero pickers), the anchor text `existing requests` that sits mid-sentence (src/settings-tab.ts), the protocol name `OpenAI-compatible` (pro/llm-register.ts) and the model id example `e.g. qwen2.5vl:7b` (src/localhost-register.ts). The `brands` override in eslint.config.mjs already covers reMarkable and Obsidian.
